questions.question: Dr. Samira must train young dentists in conflict management. What is the first piece of advice she should give them?
options: Conflicts are inevitable and should be avoided
Conflicts are an opportunity for improvement and communication
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Conflicts are an opportunity to improve communication and practice.' Dr. Malika: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika must create a dental mediation training center. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The main objective is to train dentists in conflict management and mediation.' Dr. Samira: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira must evaluate a young dentist's conflict management performance. Which measure is most important?
options: The quality of communication and conflict resolution
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The quality of communication and the ability to resolve conflicts are the most important measures.' Dr. Malika: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika must manage a crisis: a patient has filed a complaint for an ethical issue. What is the priority?
options: Protect the patient and the practice's image
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The priority is to protect the patient and the practice's image.' Dr. Samira: 'I will help you manage this crisis.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira must train interns in relational risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Risk management is an ethical responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Relational risk management is a fundamental ethical responsibility.' Dr. Malika: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika must create a guide to good mediation practices. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Good mediation practices should be based on communication science data.' Dr. Samira: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira must train young dentists in non-violent communication. What is the key message?
options: Non-violent communication is at the heart of the patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Non-violent communication is at the heart of the patient relationship.' Dr. Malika: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika must create a research program in dental mediation. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Research in dental mediation aims to improve conflict management practices.' Dr. Samira: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira must manage a reference practice in conflict management. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Excellence in conflict management is based on communication and prevention.' Dr. Malika: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika must evaluate the impact of mediation on public health. What is the role of mediation?
options: It is essential for patient trust
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Mediation is essential for patient trust.' Dr. Samira: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira must train interns in innovation in mediation. What current trend is important?
options: All of the above are correct

questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Assessment of mediation skills aims to improve practices.' Dr. Samira: 'I will participate in the assessment.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira must manage an ethical conflict. What is the right attitude?
options: Act in accordance with the Code of Ethics
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The Code of Ethics is the guide for resolving ethical conflicts.' Dr. Malika: 'I agree.'

options: Relational innovation in service of the patient

questions.question: Dr. Samira must create a quality label for practices in mediation. What are the main criteria?
options: Quality of communication and conflict management
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Quality of communication and conflict management are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Malika: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The profession needs communication enthusiasts.' Dr. Samira: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira must create a scholarship for mediation students. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Encouraging excellence in mediation is an investment for the future.' Dr. Malika: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods.' Dr. Samira: 'I will get involved in mentoring.'

options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young mediators.' Dr. Malika: 'I will support this network.'

options: Mediation is the soul of the patient relationship

questions.question: Dr. Samira, after a life dedicated to mediation, receives national recognition. Dr. Malika is by her side. What is Dr. Samira's message to young dentists?
